215.DSCR:
A pilot of the Imperial $$宇宙軍$$'s Team Top.
She hails from the Okinawa Girls' Space High School attached to the Imperial $$宇宙軍$$, commonly known as Oki-jo.
Her father was Admiral $$タカヤ・ユウゾウ$$, captain of the deep-space survey ship $$るくしおん$$.
She is a bit clumsy and scatterbrained, but has an optimistic personality. Her athletic ability is outstanding, and she has the stamina to run fifty grueling laps of the training ground unassisted, a feat that taxes even powered machinery. Her hobbies are varied, including watching anime and building plastic models.
Through an unconventional selection by her coach ($$オオタ・コウイチロウ$$), she is chosen as a candidate pilot for the Third New Robot Project alongside $$カズミ$$, the 'big sister' she admires. From then on she is assigned to the space battleship $$ヱクセリヲン$$, honing her skills alongside $$カズミ$$, $$ユング#pilot$$, and others.
In the course of the fighting, she faces numerous trials, including conflict over her pairing with $$カズミ$$ and the loss of $$スミス・トーレン$$, for whom she harbored a budding affection. But she overcomes them through the effort and guts the coach taught her, growing into the pilot of the $$ガンバスター$$, Earth's ultimate trump card for defense.
In the final battle against the $$宇宙怪獣$$, she activates a malfunctioning black hole bomb and is swallowed up by its implosion along with $$カズミ$$.

229.DSCR:
The vocalist and lead guitarist of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.
He is free-spirited and acts purely on emotion, which can make him look self-centered at first glance, but it is all the result of loving song above all else and pouring his entire being into singing. However, that same passion sometimes leads him to say and do things ordinary people simply cannot understand.
When the $$マクロス７$$ fleet made contact with the $$プロトデビルン$$, he sang on the battlefield to let them hear his song. At first this earned him the anger of those around him, $$ガムリン$$ included, but the number of people who came to understand his passion gradually grew, and in the end his singing brought the war between humanity and the $$プロトデビルン$$ to an end.
After the fighting ended, he achieved tremendous popularity through the Galaxy Network. But he suddenly set off on a carefree solo journey, and on the planet Zola he communed through song with the Galactic Whale, an energy life-form. There he was reunited with $$ガムリン$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$, who had come after him, but $$バサラ$$ left them behind and set out once more on a new journey.
His favorite foods are anything spicy. His hobbies are napping and 'making people listen to my singing'.
Few people besides himself can read the original symbols he writes on the score when composing.

234.DSCR:
A former ace pilot of the U.N. Spacy, and the fleet commander of the $$マクロス７$$ fleet and captain of $$バトル７$$.
He is the first human to have entered an interstellar marriage.
With the skill and instincts of a genius he commands $$バトル７$$ masterfully, but he was often forced onto the back foot against the $$バロータ軍$$, which appears and vanishes without warning and possesses special abilities.
Now 50 years old and more vigorous than ever, he shows no sign of his age in his looks. Perhaps for that reason, rumors of trouble with women are never lacking, and are a constant source of worry.
He and his wife $$ミリア$$ were on such good terms that they had seven girls, but the rumor is that they now quarrel constantly and live apart. He is a family man who even prioritizes a meeting with $$ミレーヌ$$ over a conference, yet he is caught between that and his responsible position, and his troubles never end.
During '$$オペレーション・スターゲイザー$$' and the decisive battle on $$バロータ第４惑星$$, he sortied himself in a VF-22S, showing piloting that betrayed no decline.

235.DSCR:
The mayor of $$シティ７$$ and a pure-blooded Meltrandi of the $$ゼントラーディ$$. She also served as deputy commander of the 37th Super-Long-Range Emigrant Fleet. 49 years old.
She and her husband $$マックス$$ quarrel constantly, their disputes growing out of statements made from their positions as representatives of the city and the military, and rumor has it they live apart.
